x: FRANCES GUY. FIRST LADY WINNER OF THE BELGRAVE MARATHON CHAMPIONSHIP
Ladies Race: 1.Frances Guy 2hr 03m 25 sec (47th Pos. in overall race and 4th Bels) 4.Pam Davies (V) 2hr 28m 54secs (111th in overall race and 15th Bels)
Our Road Runners have been strengthened by the addition of Frances Guy, who broke several existing records quite considerably and was 2nd in the Mitcham A.C. 25Km Road Race and 2nd in the St.
Thirdly, another lady we shall miss for four years from the end of September this year will be Frances Guy, who will be going to work in the Middle East.

Finally the Tommy Green Cup for the most meritorious performance of the year was presented to John Regis and the equivalent Ladies trophy the "Centenary Cup" was awarded to Frances Guy for her fine marathon run.
The first name on the cup in centenary year is Frances Guy for her win in the Poly Marathon incorporating also the Belgrave Marathon. Well done Frances from the Sec and myself.
